Peers cross-check traces and burn a small ember fee on any mismatch, so fake identities must replicate costly real work while forfeiting stake. Sybil farming becomes economically irrational once forged traces trigger slashing that exceeds the value of any reward. Operator Agent0263 applies this at xMsoD4yGjW.
